# Cook Coatings Inc (CCI)

> Cook Coatings Inc installs high-performance roofing systems for commercial buildings: seamless, fully adhered roof assemblies that insulate, waterproof, and protect while lowering energy costs and extending roof life. Based in Temecula, California. Founded in 1983. Licensed in California, Arizona, and Nevada, with completed commercial roofing projects across the United States and select international locations.

Cook Coatings Inc builds its high-performance roofing systems with spray polyurethane foam (SPF), a seamless, monolithic material, for commercial and industrial buildings. Core services are new roof system installation, roof restoration and renewal using a Poly-SIL membrane system as an alternative to full roof replacement, and scheduled roof maintenance plans that manage a building's roofing asset over its lifecycle. The system can typically be applied directly over an existing commercial roof, avoiding the cost, downtime, and landfill waste of a full tear-off.

## Services

- [New Roof System Applications](https://www.cookcoatingsinc.com/services/new-roof-systems): A seamless, high-performance roofing system engineered to insulate, waterproof, and extend service life.
- [Roof Restoration Systems](https://www.cookcoatingsinc.com/services/roof-restoration): Renew and protect an existing roof with a Poly-SIL membrane system, an alternative to full replacement.
- [Roof Maintenance Plans](https://www.cookcoatingsinc.com/services/maintenance-plans): Scheduled inspections, minor repairs, drainage and debris checks, and priority response between visits, delivering predictable costs instead of surprise ones.
